parts.text: Plan a synthetic business trip for 1 traveler from SFO to SEA. Depart 2027-01-10 and return 2027-01-13. Arrive before 2027-01-11T09:00:00-08:00. Both flight and hotel must be refundable. Hotel must be within 3000 meters of the office. Total flight and hotel budget is USD 1200. Do not book anything.
